source: Austin Land Development Code § 25-2-491 (use table) plus combining-district sections cited per case
notes: Every zoning_code is a real code on Austin's zoning polygons (data.austintexas.gov/d/xt8n-xrjg, checked 2026-10-01).
district is the base district alone: what SpotCore used before overlays were read. expected_value is that base cell.

expected_status is the correct pre-screen for the FULL zoning code, worked out from the cited sections: ETOD Tables D/E and § 25-2-653(B) are applied exactly; CO can only restrict (§ 25-2-332); NCCD/CURE can add or remove uses; MU/V add residential uses; NP/H can add uses; DBETOD permits uses not prohibited by ETOD (§ 25-2-653(G)(1)). Where the outcome depends on parcel-specific ordinance terms SpotCore can't read, the correct answer is unclear.
Same author as the implementation: these cases check that the rules are applied as written, not that the reading of the code is right. A zoning professional should review them.

cases.question: Can I open a gas station here?
cases.rule: ETOD Table D prohibits Service Station; ETOD governs over other provisions unless more restrictive (§ 25-2-653(B), (D)).

cases.question: Can I open a self storage facility here?
cases.rule: ETOD Table D prohibits Convenience Storage (§ 25-2-653(D)); DBETOD only adds uses not prohibited by ETOD (§ 25-2-653(G)(1)).

cases.question: Can I open a funeral home here?
cases.rule: ETOD Table D prohibits Funeral Services (§ 25-2-653(B), (D)).
